text:
rachel (PM): Exec wants a clear MVP/v1 boundary. We need a short, defensible cutline and a migration/comm plan by COB. My suggestion: MVP keeps basic SSO (OIDC), embeddings cache, autoscale; defers per-tenant dashboard, advanced quant profiles, and admin role tooling to v1. Also propose a CSV export + pilot signup to soften the cut.
tony (eng): +1. Cutting dashboards avoids a big ETL + UI lift. Keeping cache and autoscale preserves the latency and cost goals. Caveat: CSV export adds a small ETL path; estimate 3 dev days.
maya (eng-ml): embeddings cache is non-negotiable for short-query SLAs. Also request: add a simple metric to the release gate to catch regressed duplicate-token rates when cache is on. I'll author the eval rule.
frank (design): If we remove dashboards, we should ship a lightweight placeholder that surfaces the pilot CTA and a CSV upload/download flow. I can ship mocks in the afternoon.
nana (sales): Note: two customers (EdgeCo, BetaCorp) explicitly asked for tenant dashboards. They'll accept a pilot but need a committed migration window. We should avoid a public v1 date; instead offer a pilot slot.
sam (prod-ops): I'll include a "limited-metrics" feature flag and an internal runbook for CS. Also recommend adding a short blurb in the milestone notes explaining data coverage for MVP.
tony (eng): Proposed dev cutlist:
```
- ship (MVP): embeddings-cache, basic-SSO (OIDC), autoscale pools
- add: csv-export endpoint, feature_flag limited-metrics, pilot-signup endpoint
- defer (v1): per-tenant dashboard UI + ETL, advanced quantization profiles, admin role tools
```
rachel (PM): Good. Two questions: 1) estimate delta to original plan (story points), 2) any customer migrations required? Tony, can you post a short delta by 10:30?
tony (eng): Delta: approx -28 story points (removing dashboard/ETL) + +5 for CSV/export and flags = net -23. Migration note: current pipeline customers using internal analytics will need a one-time export; add a migration script (2 days).
maya (eng-ml): Eval PR incoming: cache duplicate-rate threshold + RPS sanity check. Will include a small script to run against canary traffic.
frank (design): Mock links: placeholder dashboard w/ pilot CTA + CSV UX ready by 4pm. Will attach in this thread.
nana (sales): I'll contact EdgeCo and BetaCorp to offer pilot slots; ask for a quick signoff if they want early access. Will push timeline but no public dates.
sam (prod-ops): Drafting release blurb and internal CS playbook. Will include suggested language for outreach and a migration checklist for clients.
release-bot: Milestone deploy window unchanged: 3305100000. Please update release checklist if any items are added/removed.
rachel (PM): Action items recap: Tony -> story point delta + migration plan by 10:30; Maya -> eval PR today; Frank -> mocks by 4pm; Sam -> release blurb + playbook by EOD; Ana -> pilot signups by EOD. I'll update the milestone board and ping execs after items are in thread. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
